certfiedShareBiogenicContent.title: Certified share - Biogenic
certfiedShareBiogenicContent.description: Biogenic fraction of material mass which has been certified by an accepted conformity assessment party regarding the traceable sustainable sourcing of the raw materials and/or manufacturing of the product, and the related determination of the share. | Beispiel(e): 0,95

certifiedShareRecycledContent.title: Certified share - Recycled
certifiedShareRecycledContent.description: Fraction of recycled material mass which has been certified by an accepted conformity assessment party regarding the traceable sustainable sourcing of the raw materials and/or manufacturing of the product, and the related determination of the share. | Beispiel(e): 0.2

totalBiogenicContent.title: Total biogenic content
totalBiogenicContent.description:
Fraction of material mass content classified as biogenic.
Note 1: Can be attributed by means of a mass balance chain of custody model as defined in ISO 22095, where applicable by sector specific rules.
Note 2: This includes all molecules/atoms (carbon and non-carbon like nitrogen) derived from biomass and excluding added water. | Beispiel(e): 0,6
totalBiogenicContent.$comment: Kein domainid im Quellmodell hinterlegt - Fallback auf 'string'.

totalRecycledContent.title: Total recycled content
totalRecycledContent.description:
Fraction of material mass content classified as recycled.
Note 1: Can be attributed by means of a mass balance chain of custody model as defined in ISO 22095. Note 2: CO2-based content for captured CO2 is classified as recycled content. | Beispiel(e): 0.2
totalRecycledContent.$comment: Kein domainid im Quellmodell hinterlegt - Fallback auf 'string'.

wasteOriginValueChainStep.title: Waste origin - value chain step
wasteOriginValueChainStep.description:
Describes the value chain step of the waste from which the reported recycled content contribution under "Waste origin - value chain step - recycled content  contribution" originates.
Reference: Circularity Guideline (https://www.chem-x.de/publication/) | Beispiel(e): Post-consumer (PCR); Post-industrial (PIR)

items.title: Waste origin - value chain step - recycled content contribution
items.description:
Amount of recycled content, as faction of material mass, obtained  from waste originating from the value chain step indicated under "Waste origin - value chain step".
Reference: Circularity Guideline (https://www.chem-x.de/publication/) | Beispiel(e): Physical recycling; Chemical recycling; etc.
